title: pouteria lamprophylla
intro: Pouteria lamprophylla, commonly known as the Babinga or Babiang tree, is a plant species belonging to the family Sapotaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects that contribute to its potential in treating various diseases.
